@@name@@Spray and Pray@@icon@@Spray and Pray.png@@icon2@@{{{icon2}}}@@description@@'''Active:''' '''Twitch''' gains [[File:Attack damage icon.svg|15px|link=Attack damage]] '''bonus''' attack damage and [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] 300 '''bonus''' attack range for 6 seconds, during which his [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attacks]] are replaced by ''bolts'' that travel slightly further than his attack range in a straight line, dealing damage to every enemy unit hit.@@description2@@The ''bolts'' deal 100% – 60% (based on enemies hit) of the triggering attack's damage, apply [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] effects, and can [[File:Critical strike icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon representing the keyword Critical strike]] [[:Critical strike|critically strike]] for (200% + [[File:Infinity Edge item.png|20xpx|border|link=Infinity Edge|An icon for the item Infinity Edge]] [[Infinity Edge|30%]]) damage.@@description3@@{{{description3}}}@@description4@@{{{description4}}}@@description5@@{{{description5}}}@@description6@@{{{description6}}}@@leveling@@
'''Bonus Attack Damage:'''
30 / 37.5 / 45 / 52.5 / 60
@@leveling2@@{{{leveling2}}}@@leveling3@@{{{leveling3}}}@@leveling4@@{{{leveling4}}}@@leveling5@@{{{leveling5}}}@@leveling6@@{{{leveling6}}}@@range@@[[File:Range model.png|20px|link=Range|An icon representing the keyword Edge range]] 1100 (+ 100% '''bonus''' [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] attack range)@@radius@@{{{radius}}}@@effectradius@@{{{effect radius}}}@@width@@[[File:Range model.png|20px|link=Range|An icon representing the keyword Edge range]] 120@@speed@@5000@@casttime@@none@@cost@@100@@cooldown@@90@@targeting@@Auto@@damagetype@@Physical@@spellshield@@@@projectile@@true@@notes@@ * The extra distance that the ''bolts'' travel scales with '''bonus''' attack range. * ''Spray and Pray'' allows '''Twitch''' to outrange [[File:Turret icon.png|20px|link=Turret|An icon representing the keyword Turret]] [[:Turret|turrets]] by 50 units, allowing him to hit them without them returning fire. * '''Twitch''' targets his line attack at his target's location at the ''start'' of his attack windup. ** The ''bolts'' reach targets at a delay, composed of '''Twitch's''' windup time and distance the ''bolt'' has to travel at finite speed. Even the primary target can dodge the attack if they are moving quickly enough. * [[File:On-attack icon.svg|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Attacking|An icon representing the keyword On-attack]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Attacking|On-attack]] effects such as [[File:Lulu Help, Pix!.png|20xpx|border|link=Lulu#Help, Pix!|An icon for Lulu's ability Help, Pix!]] [[Lulu#Help, Pix!|Help, Pix!]] and [[File:Runaan's Hurricane item.png|20xpx|border|link=Runaan's Hurricane|An icon for the item Runaan's Hurricane]] [[Runaan's Hurricane|Runaan's Hurricane's]] [[Named item effect#Wind's Fury|Wind's Fury]] will be triggered as usual from the completion of '''Twitch's''' basic attack windup. They will obey their standard target-acquisition rules in spite of ''Spray and Pray's'' special basic attack behavior. * The ''bolt'' projectiles will naturally pass through terrain and enemy structures (the latter will be damaged by ''bolts'' even if they are not directly targeted). * If '''Twitch''' is [[File:Blind icon.png|20px|link=Blind|An icon representing the keyword Blind]] [[:Blind|blinded]] before winding up the attack, the hits will ''miss'' against '''all''' targets. * [[File:Runaan's Hurricane item.png|20xpx|border|link=Runaan's Hurricane|An icon for the item Runaan's Hurricane]] [[Runaan's Hurricane|Runaan's Hurricane's]] [[Named item effect#Wind's Fury|Wind's Fury]] interacts with ''Spray and Pray's'' [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] '''bonus''' attack range but not with the modified missile effect (the secondary bolts will not have pass-through effects). * Whenever the ''bolts'' penetrate a target, a small elongated cloud appears at the location, which's VFX and SFX '''can''' be seen and heard inside the Fog of War. * The ''bolts''' travel distance scales with the full value of '''Twitch's''' [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] attack range increases such as [[File:Rapid Firecannon item.png|20xpx|border|link=Rapid Firecannon|An icon for the item Rapid Firecannon]] [[Rapid Firecannon]], but not with size increases (which only increase his effective attack range, thereby the target range). * (Outdated as of [[V10.13]], now can hit everything with edge range, except for turrets) The [[File:Range center.png|20px|link=Range|An icon representing the keyword Centered range]] center of a unit must be within the maximum travel distance of the ''bolt'' missile, and in front of the spawn location ('''Twitch's''' [[File:Range center.png|20px|link=Range|An icon representing the keyword Centered range]] center) for the ''bolt'' to be able to hit them. ** Other than this condition, the ''bolt'' missile has to only touch (pass within its half width of 60 units) the [[File:Range model.png|20px|link=Range|An icon representing the keyword Edge range]] edge of the unit's radius. ** This is standard behaviour for ''linear skillshots''. * [[File:Malignance item.png|20xpx|border|link=Malignance|An icon for the item Malignance]] [[Malignance|Malignance's]] [[Named item effect#Hatefog|Hatefog]] is special cased to work with ''Spray and Pray''. * ''Bolt'' damage is considered [[File:Mega Inferno Bomb.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Area damage]] [[:Damage|area of effect]] for [[File:Axiom Arcanist rune.png|20xpx|link=Axiom Arcanist|An icon representing Axiom Arcanist]] [[Axiom Arcanist]]. ** It is '''not''' considered ''area of effect'' for other effects, i.e [[File:Omnivamp colored icon.svg|20px|link=Vamp#Omnivamp|An icon representing the keyword Omnivamp]] [[:Vamp#Omnivamp|omnivamp]].@@
